title: MegaScale-Infer: Serving Mixture-of-Experts at Scale with Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
technique: disaggregate attention and FFN/expert modules, ping-pong pipeline over micro-batches, per-module parallelism plan, custom M2N communication library, heterogeneous deployment

optimized_metrics.evidence: we focus on maximizing the cost-normalized decoding throughput, subject to a specified time-between-tokens (TBT) latency constraint. Specifically, for homogeneous deployment, we use per-GPU decoding throughput
we focus on maximizing the cost-normalized decoding throughput ... For heterogeneous deployment, we report per-cost decoding throughput.
Our objective is to minimize the throughput per unit cost while adhering to the SLO constraint. [Titer <= SLO, Eq. 7]; Following prior work [82], we set the TBT requirement to 150 milliseconds.

headline_claim.text: MegaScale-Infer achieves up to 1.90× higher per-GPU throughput than state-of-the-art solutions.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 8a per-GPU decoding throughput; Fig 8c normalized end-to-end throughput
Fig 5/11 median and P99 communication latency vs NCCL

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we use per-GPU decoding throughput, i.e., tokens generated per second, excluding the first output token, divided by the number of GPUs
metric_definitions.notes: decode phase only; prefill excluded; output tokens only

metric_definitions.definition_quote: when measuring decoding throughput and time between tokens, we exclude the prefill phase and consider only the iteration time and output tokens of the decoding phase.
a deployment plan that maximizes throughput per unit cost
metric_definitions.notes: cost from GPU price; heterogeneous H20/L40S

slo_spec: TBT (decode iteration latency) requirement set to 150 ms following prior work [82]; search keeps Titer <= SLO and finds the largest global batch meeting the SLO via binary search
load_regime: offline decode-throughput measurement at the maximum batch size meeting the TBT SLO; no request-rate sweep
tradeoff_acknowledged: ping-pong pipeline does not reduce per-token latency of a micro-batch and may add latency; cross-node communication each layer affects latency; TBT comparable to baselines
hardware: 8 nodes x 8 NVIDIA 80GB Ampere GPUs; heterogeneous H20 + L40S cluster
workloads: decoding with fixed input/output lengths (median-length production-like), vs vLLM and TensorRT-LLM
extractor_notes: Text says 'minimize the throughput per unit cost' in §4.1, a typo for maximize (elsewhere 'maximizes throughput per unit cost'). Objective could be read as THR_TOK or COST; both recorded as objective.
